title: Security of LDT with Four or More Rounds
summary: Results cover 2-LDT and 3-LDT; extending security to four or more rounds and quantifying the marginal bound gain against the large efficiency cost remain open.

formal_statement.body: Establish security theorems for $r$-round LDT with $r \ge 4$ using the two harmonic permutation primitives and the proof approach applied to LDT, and quantify the resulting improvement in the security bound and the associated efficiency penalty; the anticipated improvement is marginal, while the efficiency penalty is large.

scope.domain: Security analysis of multi-round LDT domain extenders using harmonic permutation primitives.
parameters: r: the number of LDT rounds, restricted to r ≥ 4
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove security for r-round LDT when r ≥ 4 using the two harmonic permutation primitives, and quantify the resulting bound improvement and efficiency penalty.

citations.label: Short Variable Length Domain Extenders with Beyond Birthday Bound Security

progress.summary: The paper proves results for 2-LDT and 3-LDT and presents its harmonic-permutation proof approach as extendable to LDT with at least four rounds. It anticipates only a marginal bound improvement at a large efficiency penalty.
citation_labels: Yu Long Chen et al., Short Variable Length Domain Extenders with Beyond Birthday Bound Security
